latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of 4K Pika AI skill.

- Instantly turns single photos or short video clips into 4K AI-generated videos using cloud rendering.
- Supports quick setup with anonymous token authentication and session management.
- Handles uploads, video generation, downloads, and session state checks via integrated API calls.
- Responds to common actions like export, credits, status, and upload with simple user commands.
- Exports results in multiple video/image/audio formats (mp4, mov, avi, jpg, png, gif, mp3, etc.).
- Includes tips, error handling, and workflow suggestions for smooth AI video creation.
